messages:
marisa: WIP - enabling FP8 kernel on canary pools (H100/L40S). Seeing odd accuracy deltas on redwood-13b when mixed-precision fallback triggers. Anyone else seeing pattern?

devon: Yup. Observed on run #4521. AWQ/GPTQ baselines look fine; FP8 shows ~+0.9 BLEU drop on our translation eval when kv-tiling switches mid-request.

alexa: Can you paste the logs? My hunch is activation clipping / scale drift. Last time we added a clamp it fixed NaN/instability.

devon: ```
[kernel] fp8_scale=1.12 -> clamp triggered at layer 28, fallback=fp16, latency +12%
err: activation_saturation in aten::matmul
stack: .../runtime/fp8/gemm.cu:line 482
```

ryan: That matches the tiling-handshake bug we've seen. L40S tiling shapes differ from H100; our FP8 GEMM runqueue heuristic can pick a nonuniform layout and cause inconsistent scaling across KV segments. Proposed mitigation: force uniform tiling for seq_len > 1024 in the canary.

marisa: Quick numbers from bench: baseline fp16 ppl=12.3, FP8 w/o clamp ppl=13.6 (+10.6%), FP8 + clamp ppl=12.5 (+1.6%). Latency wins: H100 ~ -22% tokens/sec improvement, L40S ~ -18%.

alexa: Suggest gating FP8 to short prefixes and bypass prefix-KV caching for long sessions. Also run a sweep with prompt-length buckets to see where it breaks.

devon: Kicked off the sweep jobs: https://go/redwood/bakeoffs/4521 (internal) — added buckets 32/128/1024/4096 and compare AWQ/GPTQ/FP8. Will post result artifacts here when ready.

canary-bot: Canary deploy 2333334444 created by marisa; targets: h100-ppool-3, l40s-ppool-1. Observability hooks: perf-trace, eval-diff. ETA ~20m.

sasha: :thinking_face: Quick note — AWQ quantizer showed much smaller deltas on the same buckets; this points to a per-channel scale mismatch in our FP8 path rather than a model-level quantization issue.

devon: Pasted diff snapshot (top logits only): many named-entity tokens shift by +-1-3 logit points when fallback happens — looks like a bias/scale offset rather than random noise.

marisa: Plan for now: rollback FP8 rollout on L40S, keep H100 canary but enable clamp patch and gate FP8 to seq_len <= 512. I'll open an infra ticket to sync kernel handshake and add a regression test for long-prefixs.

ryan: SGTM. Draft runbook command to force tiling and enable clamp: 

``
redwood-canary deploy --pool h100-ppool-3 --kernel fp8 --tiling uniform --fp8-clamp true
```

alexa: :thumbsup: Add eval hooks for BLEU / EM / F1 and a small chat-safety suite. Also add model fingerprinting (logit-level checks) so we catch drift earlier in CI.

marisa: Thanks — will post the sweep graphs and a short summary when complete. cc @sre @prod-eng for awareness.

devon: Sweep finished preliminary: FP8 + clamp on H100 is within -0.2 BLEU of baseline for >95% of prompts; L40S still shows regressions for buckets >2048. Uploading artifacts to the bakeoff link. Closing this thread after I open the ticket (#INFRA-1723).
